description:
Run your whole home from 8 Excel workbooks: meals and groceries, pantry and freezer, chores and laundry, upkeep, inventory and warranties, the family calendar, documents and renewals, projects. Type your own data and see what to cook first, who carries which chores, what is overdue and what is due in the next 90 days.

Home and family organizer apps are usually billed every month or every year, and single planner sheets cover only one job. This is 29 dollars, once.

Built for a single adult, a couple or a family with children, owners or renters, and for a shared home where members type their own names. Not for budgets, bills, debt or savings (that is another suite). It is a set of workbooks you type into, not an app, a reminder service or a safety service, and it gives no advice.

What you get:
✓ 8 workbooks for one household, each working on its own and using the same household names, rooms and lists: Meal Plan and Grocery List; Pantry, Freezer and Leftovers; Chores, Laundry and Rotation; Home Maintenance and Repairs; Home Inventory and Warranties; Family Calendar, Pets and Vehicles; Documents, Contacts and Renewals; Projects, Hosting and Declutter
✓ {pages} ready pages: dashboards, tools, printable forms, documents, checklists and ready messages
✓ Every workbook holds 20 tables, 18 tools, 12 forms, 12 documents, 12 checklists, 34 message texts, 30 dashboard numbers, 22 charts and 6 gauges: 160 tables, 144 tools, 96 forms, 96 documents, 96 checklists, 272 message texts, 240 dashboard numbers, 176 charts and 48 gauges in all
✓ Each part as a blank workbook plus a copy filled with sample data, so every page works before you type your own
✓ Standard .xlsx files for Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets and LibreOffice, with "Make a copy" links for Google Sheets. No macros, no subscription
✓ Dates follow your computer's regional format and the currency symbol changes in one cell. Formula cells are locked against accidental edits (no password), input cells are clearly coloured and the first sheet has instructions

How it works: 1) open the workbook for the job and read its first sheet, 2) replace the sample rows with your own in the coloured cells, 3) open it each week and read what is due, overdue or clashing, all calculated from your entries. Intervals, use-by dates and warranty ends are the ones you type; the suggestions are typical, so check the manual and the label.

Guarantee: if a file does not work as described, we fix it, replace it or refund you within 14 days.

Questions about Google Sheets, shared homes, reminders and refunds are answered in the FAQ below. One payment, instant download.

faq.q: Which programs does it work in, and are there macros or a subscription?
faq.a: The files are standard .xlsx files for Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets and LibreOffice, and "Make a copy" links for Google Sheets are included. They are built with the same engine as our published suites, which we tested in Google Sheets. No macros, no add-ins, no subscription: you pay once and download.

faq.q: Can I change the currency and the date format?
faq.a: Yes. Dates follow your computer's regional format, and the currency symbol changes in one cell. Money appears only as simple cost lines of a repair, a purchase, a gift or a project.

faq.q: Does it fit a couple, a family with children and a shared home?
faq.a: Yes. The sample household has two adults, two children, a grandparent who helps, a dog and a cat. A couple leaves the child rows empty, a single adult also leaves the pet rows empty, a shared home types its members as household members, and renters read "a trade" as "a maintenance request to the landlord".

Yes. Keep one workbook per job, for example the meal plan or the chore chart, in a shared folder of your own drive and let everyone open the same file. Your data stays in your own files and there are no accounts.

faq.q: Does it send reminders or update by itself?
faq.a: No. There is no app and nothing runs in the background. You type or paste your data, and each workbook shows what is due, overdue or clashing when you open it, calculated from your entries.

faq.q: What if a file does not work as described?
faq.a: We fix it, replace it or refund you within 14 days. That is the store's policy for every file.
